_comment: Field definitions for PIGBROTHER (.tdms) data files. Each entry maps a Group/Channel key to {description, symbol, unit}. unit must be a pint-parseable string; use null for dimensionless/time columns. 'aliases' maps housing-independent cross-references to pupitre (column name) and hybrid (FEPC_system/variable key). Housing-dependent mappings (e.g. Référence_GR1 = IH vs IB depending on housing) belong in site_config.py.
